tools.name: get_bequest_language
tools.description: Return sample bequest wording for a will or trust that gives a percentage or dollar amount to causes or named charities, for the person or their attorney to adapt. Use for quick questions like "how do I word a gift to charity in my will?"

tools.name: get_state_will_requirements
tools.description: Look up how to sign a valid will in a U.S. state: witnesses, notarization and self-proving affidavits, handwritten (holographic) wills, electronic wills and remote online notarization, plus the state's estate or inheritance tax, with statute links.

tools.name: lookup_charity
tools.description: Find a U.S. charity's exact legal name, EIN (federal tax ID), city and state, and 501(c)(3) status from IRS filings (via ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer), with ready-to-use bequest and beneficiary-form wording. tools.name: list_causes
tools.description: List the cause areas MyLastWill supports for charitable gifts (e.g. cancer research, rare diseases, education, animal welfare, global health), with what each gift would be used for.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search MyLastWill.org's plain-English guides, state will requirements, FAQ and glossary about wills, estates, charitable bequests, estate tax and online signing. Returns result ids for fetch.

tools.description: Fetch the full text of a guide, state page, FAQ answer or glossary entry by the id returned from search.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
